aboutH2: Red Road Recovery: Addiction Treatment Above Shuswap Lake in Sorrento, BC
intro: Welcome to Red Road Recovery, a premier addiction treatment center located in Sorrento, British Columbia, Canada. At Red Road Recovery, we are dedicated to providing comprehensive and compassionate care to individuals struggling with addiction and co-occurring disorders.

Our approach to treatment is unique, as we blend evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices. We believe that healing must address the whole person (mind, body, and spirit) and strive to create an environment that nurtures all aspects of our clients’ well-being.

pillars.title: Idyllic Location
pillars.body: Nestled on a hillside overlooking Shuswap lake and the surrounding mountains, Red Road Recovery’s facility offers a breathtaking location for healing and reflection. Shared rooms with scenic views, ensuite bathrooms, a spacious outdoor deck area, and large common areas provide luxurious amenities to clients. Red Road Recovery’s holistic program, combined with the stunning setting, makes it an ideal choice for those seeking to treat addiction and co-occurring disorders simultaneously.

pillars.title: Personalized Treatment
pillars.body: Red Road Recovery creates individualized treatment plans to address the specific needs of each client using the bio-psycho-social model. They integrate evidence-based therapies like talk therapy, narrative therapy, and creative therapies with the 12-Step philosophy. Their comprehensive approach includes 30, 60, and 90-day residential treatment options, as well as outpatient treatment, virtual care, family counseling, and aftercare services. Each program emphasizes the overall health of the client through nutritional meals, fitness and exercise, massage, relaxation therapy, yoga, and more.

pillars.title: A Sorrento Team That Has Lived It
pillars.body: Deana Slack runs the house as Executive Director. She is a certified addiction counsellor and Medication-Assisted Treatment Specialist who has trained in crisis intervention, and her published bio speaks about her own recovery and her ancestral ties to the Coast Salish peoples. Evan Haukedal, the Clinical Manager, came to counselling after his own inpatient treatment and uses CBT, trauma-informed care and motivational interviewing. Counsellors Stacy Bishop, a former nurse, and Michelle Whalley round out the clinical side, while David Villanueva leads cultural programming. Red Road says every staff member has personal experience in recovery.

overview: Red Road Recovery provides a serene and secure environment for those seeking to overcome drug and alcohol addiction and co-occurring disorders. With a focus on holistic healing, they blend conventional treatment techniques with indigenous healing practices to promote the restoration of the mind, body, and spirit. Collaborating with the local indigenous people, Red Road incorporates medicine wheel teachings and sweat lodge ceremonies to enhance the therapeutic benefits of nature.

location.heading: Red Road Recovery in Sorrento, British Columbia
location.intro: The house is at 1650 Trans-Canada Highway in Sorrento, on the hillside above the south shore of Shuswap Lake, with Salmon Arm about 25 minutes east and Kamloops roughly an hour west. From Vancouver the drive takes about 5 hours by the Coquihalla through Kamloops, and Kelowna is around 1 hour 45 minutes south through Vernon.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.a: Red Road Recovery is a premier addiction treatment center located in Sorrento, British Columbia, Canada. We offer a unique approach to treatment that blends evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices.

faqs.q: How much does Red Road Recovery cost?
faqs.a: Red Road Recovery does not publish its fees, and its website asks you to contact the team for pricing. The cost depends on the type of bed you take and on program length, which runs 30, 45, 60 or 90 days. Admissions can explain current rates and the public funding options on 250-800-3190.

Yes. Red Road holds a CMHA grant that pays for 23 publicly funded beds across its network, free for BC residents aged 19 and over, with no income check. Private beds are open to anyone, and First Nations clients can apply for an FNHA subsidy. Ask admissions which house has an open funded bed, since this page does not say how many sit in Sorrento.

faqs.q: What is the length of your treatment programs?
faqs.a: The length of our treatment programs varies depending on each individual’s needs. We offer both short-term and long-term programs to accommodate a range of recovery journeys.

faqs.q: Does Red Road Recovery offer detox?
faqs.a: No, there is no detox at the Sorrento house. Red Road asks that you be detoxed or medically fit for treatment on the day you arrive, so arrange withdrawal management through your doctor or health authority first. Admissions can talk through timing with you.

faqs.q: Where is Red Road Recovery and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The house is at 1650 Trans-Canada Highway in Sorrento, overlooking Shuswap Lake in BC's Interior. It is about 5 hours by car from Vancouver, roughly an hour from Kamloops and about 25 minutes from Salmon Arm. Kamloops Airport is the closest regular airport.

faqs.q: Who can apply, and what are the admission rules?
faqs.a: Adults 19 and over can apply, either on their own or through a First Nation Band, health authority, shelter or counsellor. The houses are co-ed, so applicants with sexual charges or offences are not accepted. You fill in the admissions package and send it by email or fax to 1-250-410-3448, or complete it by phone.

Our treatment approach is holistic and focuses on treating the whole person: mind, body, and spirit. We blend evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices to create a comprehensive treatment plan that addresses each individual’s unique needs.
Yes, we offer aftercare support to all of our clients to help them maintain their recovery after leaving our facility.

Red Road offers aftercare that includes virtual one-to-one counselling and support meetings. The original listing also names family follow-up counselling, a recovery coach and return visits. Your counsellor plans the next steps with you before discharge.

faqs.q: What types of addiction do you treat?
faqs.a: We treat a variety of addictions, including alcohol, drugs, gambling, and more.

faqs.q: Is Red Road Recovery a residential facility?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer residential treatment programs in a safe and supportive environment where our clients can focus on their recovery without distractions from the outside world.

faqs.q: What qualifications do your staff members have?
faqs.a: Our staff members are highly qualified and experienced professionals in the addiction treatment field. We have licensed therapists, counselors, and medical professionals on staff to ensure the highest quality of care.
We accept most major insurance plans, and our admissions team can help you determine your coverage.
